title: [DOC-10] Profiles disagree on the `KeyPackageEndpoint` service `type` string
description: Review finding DOC-10: Profiles disagree on the `KeyPackageEndpoint` service `type` string (lens DOC). Location: profiles/o365-employer-did.md:158, :238; profiles/discord-onboarding.md:211; spec/07-compliance.md:185-190; spec/02-identity.md:302. Fix: The existing text already settles this. spec/02-identity.md:302 says the provisioning service "MUST add a `KeyPackageEndpoint` service entry (§7.8.2)", and §7.8.2's only example (07-compliance.md:190) uses `"type": "AgoraKeyPackageEndpoint"`. The name also matches the `Agora*` service naming. Change o365:158 and :238 to `AgoraKeyPackageEndpoint`, and add one sentence to spec §2.5.3 or §7.8.2 that states the type string normatively. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
